records.text: Michelle Fields alleged that Corey Lewandowski assaulted her at a 2016 event and displayed bruises.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: apparently assaulted a reporter that was working at Breitbart, Michelle Fields, at an event. Michelle Fields comes out and says that this happened. She even shows bruises, right?

verification.notes: Police records and contemporaneous reporting confirm Fields alleged Lewandowski grabbed her, filed a report, and displayed bruising on her forearm.

sources.title: Donald Trump's Campaign Manager Charged for Grabbing Reporter
sources.relevance: Reports Fields's allegation, police video assessment, and documented forearm bruising.

records.text: Ben Shapiro and Michelle Fields resigned from Breitbart on March 13, 2016.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: So on March 13th, 2016, Ben (Ben Shapiro) and Michelle Fields doubly decided that they were going to leave Breitbart in a glorious public statement that they would both make.

verification.notes: Contemporaneous reports confirm both Shapiro and Fields resigned from Breitbart on March 13, 2016.

sources.title: Upheaval at Breitbart over dustup with Donald Trump campaign
sources.relevance: Contemporaneous AP/CBS report confirms Shapiro and Fields resigned on March 13, 2016.

records.text: Ben Shapiro accused Steve Bannon of betraying Andrew Breitbart's mission by backing Corey Lewandowski, who Shapiro said allegedly assaulted Michelle Fields, at Fields's expense.
records.speaker: Ben Shapiro

appearances.snippet: Breitbart News under the chairmanship of Steve Bannon has put a stake through the heart of Andrew (Andrew Breitbart)'s legacy. ... In order to protect Trump's bully campaign manager, Corey Lewandowski, who allegedly assaulted Michelle (Michelle Fields).

verification.notes: Shapiro's published resignation statement accused Bannon of betraying Andrew Breitbart's mission and protecting Trump and Lewandowski at Fields's expense.

sources.title: Shapiro Resigns From Breitbart News
sources.relevance: Publishes the quoted accusations against Bannon and Breitbart management.

records.text: Ben Shapiro and Jamie Weinstein manufactured the Michelle Fields scandal to give The Daily Wire momentum.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep zSKrxIUMNqw)

appearances.snippet: And they decided to do that. They decided to create a scandal because there was no energy behind it. ... And his best friend Jamie Weinstein decided to cook up a scandal.

verification.notes: Police and prosecutorial review found video evidence that Lewandowski grabbed Fields and probable cause for battery. No reliable evidence supports the claim that Shapiro and Weinstein manufactured the incident to launch The Daily Wire.

sources.title: Florida state attorneys explain why they did not prosecute Corey Lewandowski
sources.relevance: Reports that prosecutors found probable cause and video evidence of the grab, contradicting a manufactured-incident premise.

sources.title: Donald Trump's Campaign Manager Charged for Grabbing Reporter
sources.relevance: Documents the police report, video, and bruising; provides no evidence of a Shapiro-Weinstein fabrication.

records.text: Candace Owens said Jamie Weinstein was a political journalist and podcaster, believed he was working for National Review at the time, and said he was Michelle Fields's husband.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And his best friend Jamie Weinstein decided to cook up a scandal. And if you're wondering who Jamie Weinstein is, he's a political journalist. He's a podcaster. ... At that time, I believe he was working for the National Review, ... Jamie Weinstein is Michelle (Michelle Fields)'s husband.

verification.notes: Weinstein's biography and contemporaneous profiles identify him as a political journalist, National Review Online podcaster, and Fields's husband.

sources.title: Michelle Fields Is Shopping a TV Show Based on Her Dinner Parties
sources.relevance: Contemporaneous profile identifies Fields's husband as National Review Online podcaster Jamie Weinstein.

sources.title: About Jamie Weinstein
sources.relevance: Weinstein's own biography identifies him as an opinion journalist and podcast host.

records.text: Released video showed that Michelle Fields's bruises were not where Corey Lewandowski touched her.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: It was later proved that the bruises could not have been from Corey Lewandowski,

verification.notes: Police described the video as showing Lewandowski grab Fields's left arm and documented finger-shaped bruising on her left forearm; prosecutors found probable cause. The claim that the video proved the bruises were elsewhere is contradicted by that record.

sources.title: Donald Trump's Campaign Manager Charged for Grabbing Reporter
sources.relevance: The police report describes a left-arm grab and finger-shaped bruising on Fields's left forearm.

sources.title: Florida state attorneys explain why they did not prosecute Corey Lewandowski
sources.relevance: Prosecutors reviewed the video and bruise photo and found probable cause, contrary to the claimed exoneration.

records.text: The Fields-Lewandowski scandal permanently damaged Breitbart News.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: By then the damage had been done to Breitbart. They never recovered, by the way. Breitbart never recovered from this scandal

verification.notes: The scandal clearly preceded resignations and internal turmoil, but 'permanently damaged' and 'never recovered' are undefined causal judgments that cannot be verified as stated.
